paragraphs: Yosef son of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi asked Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi: Ellu Terefot 56b. He was the Nasi’s son-in-law: Ellu Terefot and Kiddushin 33b. His father rose before him because he married into the Nasi’s family. He fell ill and fell into a deathlike state; afterwards he said: ‘I saw an inverted world’: Pesachim 50a. Bava Batra 10b has ‘Yosef be-Rav Yehoshua’; it should read ‘son of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi,’ as in Ein Yaakov. For ‘I saw an inverted world,’ see Rav Yehudah bar Yechezkel. Yuchasin writes: ‘Rav Huna be-Rav Yehoshua fell ill and fell into a deathlike state’; see his entry. Zeaira bar Chama told him: ‘Son of a learned man, I shall tell you excellent things your father did’; see his entry.
